authorId.description: The account ID of the user who created this version.

message.description: Message associated with the current version.

createdAt.description: Date and time when the version was created. In format "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ".

minorEdit.description: Describes if this version is a minor version. Email notifications and activity stream updates are not created for minor versions.

contentTypeModified.description: Describes if the content type is modified in this version (e.g. page to blog)

collaborators.description: The account IDs of users that collaborated on this version.

prevVersion.description: The version number of the version prior to this current content update.

nextVersion.description: The version number of the version after this current content update.
